# Zotero Forums

> Community forum for Zotero users to discuss features, report bugs, share support, and participate in beta testing of new functionality.

Zotero Forums is the primary community hub for users of Zotero, an open-source reference management tool. The forum hosts discussions about Zotero across desktop and mobile platforms (iOS, Android), integrations with Google Docs and Microsoft Word, PDF handling, sync issues, and upcoming features.

## Key Topics

- Zotero
- PDF reader
- iOS app
- Android app
- Google Docs integration
- Microsoft Word integration
- Sync issues
- Beta testing
- Bug reports
- Feature requests
- Zotero 7 & 8
- EPUB support
- Group libraries
- Zotero Connector
- Community support

## Forum Navigation

- [Recent Discussions - Zotero Forums](https://forums.zotero.org): Zotero Forums homepage showcasing recent discussions and community activity
- [Recent Discussions - Zotero Forums](https://forums.zotero.org/discussions): Main forum discussions page for Zotero community support and announcements

## Beta Testing & Announcements

- [Available for beta testing: Recently Read collection - Zotero Forums](https://forums.zotero.org/discussion/130449/available-for-beta-testing-recently-read-collection): Beta testing announcement for Recently Read collection feature
- [Available for beta testing: Read Aloud - Zotero Forums](https://forums.zotero.org/discussion/130097/available-for-beta-testing-read-aloud): Beta testing announcement for Read Aloud text-to-speech feature
- [Available for beta testing: Added By and Modified By for group libraries - Zotero Forums](https://forums.zotero.org/discussion/130450/available-for-beta-testing-added-by-and-modified-by-for-group-libraries): Beta testing announcement for group library metadata tracking features
- [Coming soon: New item fields - Zotero Forums](https://forums.zotero.org/discussion/121656/coming-soon-new-item-fields): Feature announcement for new item fields in Zotero 7.1

- [Recent Discussions - Zotero Forums (Page 4)](https://forums.zotero.org/discussions/p4): Forum discussions featuring Zotero 7, Android app, and PDF reader support
- [Recent Discussions - Zotero Forums (Page 5)](https://forums.zotero.org/discussions/p5): Forum discussions with technical help for Zotero 7, EPUB, and WebDAV
- [Recent Discussions - Zotero Forums (Page 6)](https://forums.zotero.org/discussions/p6): Forum discussions on sync issues, Zotero 7/8, and mobile platform support

- [Recent Discussions - Zotero Forums (Page 100)](https://forums.zotero.org/discussions/p100): Forum discussions on mobile apps, Word integration, and sync problems
